name: Nur Coffee & Work
tagline: A bright café-coworking with panoramic windows: coffee, sockets at every table and a quiet room

listing.description: A website for a café-coworking, learning centre or studio: bright and clean, priced services, team and steps.

seo.title: Nur — café-coworking with panoramic windows in Tashkent
seo.description: Coffee and a workspace in one: sockets at every table, fast Wi-Fi, a quiet room and a meeting room. A day pass with coffee is 90,000 UZS. 59 Mustaqillik St.
seo.answer: Nur is a café-coworking on the 3rd floor of 59 Mustaqillik St, open 8:00–22:00 on weekdays and from 9:00 at weekends. Cappuccino is 30,000 UZS, a day pass with two drinks 90,000 UZS, and a 6-person meeting room 120,000 UZS an hour. Every table has sockets, Wi-Fi runs at 300 Mbps.

sections.title: Coffee with daylight and a socket
sections.subtitle: Third floor, floor-to-ceiling windows and forty seats: a socket at every table, no calls in the quiet room. Coffee is brought to your table.

sections.label: About
sections.title: A café that’s good to work in
sections.text: We built a place where you don’t have to choose between good coffee and a proper desk. A main room for those who like the sound of the espresso machine, a quiet room with library rules and a glass meeting room. Baristas brew with beans from Tashkent roasters.

items.title: Cappuccino
items.text: And everything from the espresso bar.

items.title: Day pass
items.text: A seat until closing and any two drinks.

items.title: Monthly pass
items.text: A fixed desk in the quiet room and coffee every day.

items.title: Meeting room
items.text: Up to 6 people, screen and whiteboard.

items.title: Book
items.text: Via the button on the site, or just come — on weekdays before 10:00 there’s always room.

items.title: Pick a room
items.text: Main for talking, quiet for focus.

items.title: Work
items.text: Coffee comes to your table; pay when you leave.

items.quote: Finally a café where you don’t have to hunt for a socket. I work here three days a week.
items.author: Laziz T.

items.quote: We held a client meeting in the meeting room — screen, whiteboard and cappuccinos for everyone.
items.author: Gulnora Sh.

items.q: Can I sit with a laptop without a pass?
items.a: Yes, in the main room with any order, up to two hours. Longer needs a day pass.
Yes, the business centre’s underground car park, first two hours free.
In the main room with headphones; not in the quiet room. There are two phone booths.
Sandwiches, salads and pastries all day.

sections.label: Shop
sections.title: Coffee for home
sections.text: Add to cart and check out — we will call to confirm and deliver.
